d:
Bloomberg White House correspondent Hadriana Lowenkron tells Bloomberg This Weekend that President Donald Trump may look for areas of cooperation with a Democratic-controlled Congress after the midterms, including credit card interest rates, health care and immigration. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Lowenkron also explains how the White House is responding to recent aviation infrastructure problems as affordability and other domestic concerns take on greater political importance.
